---
title: "Exponent after set notation"
format:
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - ../macros-pdf-header.tex
      - ../macros.qmd
---

An exponent after a set-builder set or a set difference must rise over a tall argument.

```{=latex}
\newsavebox{\withexp}\newsavebox{\withoutexp}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\setbuild{x \in \frac{a}{b}}{x > 0}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\setbuild{x \in \frac{a}{b}}{x > 0}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt SETBUILDEXPRISES\else SETBUILDEXPSTUCK\fi
\sbox{\withexp}{$\setdiff{\frac{a}{b}}{B}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\setdiff{\frac{a}{b}}{B}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt SETDIFFEXPRISES\else SETDIFFEXPSTUCK\fi
```

The rejected form is the control: an unbraced body must not rise, so the test can fail.

```{=latex}
\newcommand{\unbracedcontrol}[1]{\mathrm{P}\paren{#1}}
\sbox{\withexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}^2$}
\sbox{\withoutexp}{$\unbracedcontrol{\frac{a}{b}}$}
\par\ifdim\dimexpr\ht\withexp-\ht\withoutexp\relax>1.5pt CTRLRISES\else CTRLSTUCK\fi
```
